title: Acquire a capped cloud sampler with its square-root dimension cost
statement: For every raw conservative globally L-Lipschitz C1,1 source,sigma>0 and0<epsilon<=1/4,the specified finite positive cloud program has ideal-real TV<=epsilon from N(Eg(G),sigma^2I). With the exact source(2) parameters,its every-execution query cap is1+A[M+8JK]. At fixed L/sigma,this is sqrt(d) up to logarithms,not the N687 polylog dimension target.

requires: Original whole-vector g values,exact Gaussians and real arithmetic
Complete source parameters p,M,alpha,K,A,J,s,r and finite Poisson constants
Fresh maps conditional on retained Brownian paths;reuse identical action seeds at the two input evaluations
provides: Odd homogeneous two-value secant with fixed-seed Lipschitz<=sqrt(2)L;four-value covariance action with charged relative bias
Finite on-demand bridges acquire the needed Brownian anchors
Positive Poisson-product clipping likelihood and explicit attempt/count caps
Full characteristic-function martingale and tilt/bias/tail/shift proof
Fresh adaptive invocations compose by summing uniform conditional errors,each paying its full cap
assumptions: Exact oracle reals have no invented bit bound
Code/diagnostics not newly executed by curator
Source attributes core cloud methodology to prior work;no external novelty clearance
costs: K-word estimators,J factors and A proposals count all rejected proposals and the offset query
O(dA(M+JK)) vector work plus bridge/index/precomputation;O(d(M+JK)) storage
Secant cancellation,Gaussian approximations and roundoff need a separate finite-bit budget
contract.units: Every-execution whole-vector queries and full ideal-real TV
contract.obstruction: Uncapped bounded-global-tilt averaged-proposal error tends to1 when M=o(sqrt(d)) at fixed nonzero affine ratio. Caps subtract delta_cap from the proved lower bound. More word order alone does not remove this defect;g(0) solves that affine mean family exactly.

evidence.range_scope: Self-contained capped positive Gaussian-cloud value program,full-law proof,all proposals/actions/bridges and bounded-tilt architecture obstruction.

evidence.quote: Decision: accept the listed mathematical/program interfaces
evidence.range_scope: Completed unblinded source-read curator reconstruction of these exact proofs;ideal-real mathematical scope only,no scientific code execution or unseen earlier audit transfer.

body: The leading likelihood size is alpha sqrt(d),not the higher-order truncation. Covariance/mean oracles and unbounded rejection are not runtime inputs. Older fixed-exponent/bounded-input competitors keep their actual contracts.

review.scope: Actual completed audit is a separate version-bound overlay.
